verdict.rationale: A tax-filing portal could plausibly offer user-configured background automations such as scheduled payments or recurring filings, so the axis applies. The evidence shows only manual, interactive MyDOR workflows. The Small Business Credit auto-calculation, saved drafts, one-time ACH debit and the 24/7 automated phone line are adjacent features, not autonomous automations a user sets up, and probes found no API or OpenAPI surface.
